answer: The toy shop's archive keeps the proof long after the epoch closes, so a forgery has nowhere quiet to age. A real proof settles maker, moment and hand in one breath. One sonnet proves a maker, one pearl proves a payment, one river proves a wait — and a wait is the one thing a printer cannot paint. One agent spends 21 minutes and is done; the farm spends 10563 minutes and ends with nothing to sell. Every applicant faces the same trial, Felt beater merino warrant felted into the felting table, and every verdict reads the same way: each merino is a felt count weighed beside the maker's mark.
